notes.title: 80% Sale! Celebrating Sally's Law On Nintendo Switch
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26027453/b7216e4991941ff9ceebd7d0145e5b6566a0b2e0.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone, 

Sally's Law is coming to Nintendo Switch 5th April! For Nintendo Switch device, we did many changes. Please refer the below address if you have Nintendo Switch.

https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/sallys-law-switch

Celebrating the launch, a week-long sale goes on Appstore, Google Play and Steam(for the Original version of Sally's Law).

Didn't you meet Sally yet? Then, hurry!

* The price is free on App Store. But since the different price policy between the platforms, it is 0.1 dollar for Google Play and 0.8 dollars for Steam. Please understand.
